findings.detail: The raw SOI shows amortized cost and fair value as dollar-denominated amounts, but the extracted cost_currency is the XBRL unit id U_USD rather than normalized USD.

rationale: FX03 is a Class 1 currency-unit check on cost_currency. The source SOI uses dollar-denominated amortized cost and fair value columns, including table 13 row 5 where the cost and fair value values are preceded by dollar signs. The extracted observed value U_USD is therefore not a source currency but an unnormalized XBRL unit identifier; the expected stored currency is USD.
